subject: Re: Kickoff: infinite-width uncertainty & calibration audit
body: Status on the repro milestone. The ESS sampler is running under jax.vmap across 32 parallel chains; on the precomputed Myrtle-10 kernels we reproduce the paper's qualitative result — the NNGP posterior is markedly better calibrated than its finite-width analogue. On our CIFAR-10 subset (10k test) we're seeing ECE 0.019 for the NNGP with the softmax link vs 0.041 for the finite-width ensemble baseline. Two flags: (1) chain mixing degrades on the 45k-example kernel — we need roughly 3x more ESS iterations than budgeted, which pushes the full grid to ~4 days on best-effort titan; (2) the kernel mirror is 78 GB and the storage quota request is still pending with Corpus. Neither blocks the late-April report if the quota clears this week. — Halima
